slides.dek: A deep green that reads like old money, and the three colours that keep it quiet.

slides.name: Chalk Cream
slides.body: Every wall, the ceiling, the trim. Green this deep needs a pale, warm field around it or the room closes in.

slides.name: Study Green
slides.body: Cabinetry, a bookcase wall, or the island. One committed surface beats four scattered accents.

slides.name: Walnut
slides.body: Deep green goes cold next to pale ash. Walnut and oiled teak carry the warmth this palette runs on.

slides.name: Aged Bronze
slides.body: A picture light, a lamp stem, a sculptural bowl. A mellow metal seals the scheme; chrome would cut it.

slides.h: Deep green needs warm wood beside it.
body: Every convincing green room leans on timber: shelves, a desk, a floor in oak or walnut.
The wood reads as age, and age is what makes green read expensive.
